# Meet the data

## The two inputs

| File | First column | Other columns |
|---|---|---|
| `data/my-study/gene-counts.tsv` | `gene_id` (one unique gene per row) | One nonnegative integer count column per sample |
| `data/my-study/sample-metadata.tsv` | `sample_id` (one unique sample per row) | Design variables, including a condition column |

The current script accepts `group` with A/B for a simple replicated comparison, or `cell` plus `dex` with the airway paired layout. Your study may require a different design, level names, covariates or contrast: review and edit the script before inference. Do not rename real conditions A/B merely to force them through this template.

To inspect just the header and first few rows in R:

```r
head(read.delim("data/my-study/gene-counts.tsv", check.names = FALSE)[, 1:4])
head(read.delim("data/my-study/sample-metadata.tsv"))
```

Run those lines in an R console in the main project folder. Gene IDs are labels, not gene symbols unless the source annotation says so.
